needed.evidence: shops open directly onto the carriageway with no designated walking area
needed.suggestion: Construct a dedicated footway on the left side to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

needed.evidence: uneven pavement and debris along the kerb edge
needed.suggestion: Level and repair the surface of the right-side sidewalk to remove trip hazards.

needed.evidence: pedestrians are crossing the road in the carriageway without any designated facility
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing to provide a safe place for people to cross the street.

needed.evidence: lack of markings or signals makes crossing unpredictable and dangerous
needed.suggestion: Implement a signalised or raised crossing to improve safety and visibility.

needed.evidence: the kerb is high and continuous without dropped sections for accessibility
needed.suggestion: Install dropped kerbs at designated crossing points to improve accessibility for all users.

needed.evidence: no street lighting poles visible along the urban road segment
needed.suggestion: Install street lighting along the road to improve visibility and safety at night.
